hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Mixpad token launches that collects a platform swap fee on every trade, splitting it between the token creator and treasury. Includes a decaying anti-snipe surcharge on buys in the blocks immediately after launch, a time-limited surcharge on deployer sells, and auto-executes a buyback-and-burn of the launched token using a configurable portion of the creator's fee share.
